questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are still to be taken (not yet carried out)?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the policy, or the file, show that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Does the file state that the measures could not wait for the insurer's instruction because of imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug)?

questions.label: Q7
questions.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen or damaged by a theft outside the insured location that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery)?

text:
Dear Ms Morgan,

I'll start with the bad news: I have no receipts for any of the things that were taken, and there's no way of getting them. The watch was my grandfather's, the phone I bought second-hand from a colleague, and the wallet and the cash obviously never came with a receipt. I asked around, but nobody can give me a duplicate.

The good news, I hope, is that I've had the CSS supplementary cover for simple theft away from home since July 2025.

One thing I still have to do is have the phone blocked by its IMEI number with my provider. I haven't done it yet because the number is on the original box, which is somewhere in my parents' attic. I'll go and look this weekend.

Now to what happened, and here I'm honestly not sure how to describe it. On Saturday 5 September 2026 I was at the lake festival in Lucerne with my friend Peter Imhof. Around 11 at night, in the crowd near the fireworks, a man barged into me so hard that I fell over. He helped me up, said sorry, and disappeared. A few minutes later I noticed my wallet, phone and watch were gone, about CHF 8,500 in total. Peter is convinced the man knocked me down on purpose to rob me. I'm not sure: it was packed, people were pushing everywhere, and it may just have been a collision that a pickpocket used. I really can't say which it was.

There was nothing I had to do urgently before hearing from you, and I didn't.

No bicycle was involved, I'd walked to the festival.

One last thing: the inside pocket of my jacket was ripped open in the scuffle. I've since had it sewn up at the tailor's, so the tear can no longer be seen.

Best regards,
David Keller
Hofackerstrasse 72, Luzern
